verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document any way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. TURN credential generation (docs-23) is not described as scoped. RealtimeKit participant permissions (docs-34) and DataChannel grant/revoke (docs-9) are in-meeting media controls, not API credential scoping, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
